lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Melania Trump calls for lasting Ukraine truce as she hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials, BBC News reports.
There are 548 people on death row in California, The Associated Press reports.
Palestine Action ban appeal enters closed proceedings at UK Supreme Court, Middle East Eye reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
